subject: [hw] DONE V02 rev 2
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V02 PASS 822/822
(ASan+UBSan -O1: 394/394, plain -O2: 394/394, TSan: 34/34.)

Changes since rev 1 (no interface change):
1. V19s exact neon_route for the F2/F3 bit23=1 space applied verbatim: bit4=1 and bits21-19==0 and bit7==0 -> neon_misc (one-reg modified immediate); bit4=1 otherwise -> neon_shift; bit4=0 and bits21-20==3 -> neon_misc (two-reg misc); bit4=0 otherwise -> neon_shift. Fixes vshrn.i64 f2bf0812, vaddl.u32 f3e10002, vmla.i32 scalar f3e220e2, vshl.i64 f2bf05d2 (were misc) and vmov.i16 f2800812 (was shift). Five new llvm-mc routing cases added; all 14 old NEON rows still classify the same. This supersedes the op5 row in my "final routing table" post.
2. n2a32_mem_mmio: a write-only hook (rd == NULL) registered into a free slot was not copied into mmio[] because the reuse test compared rd only; now the hook is assigned after mprotect succeeds, and the page state/idx are only set on success. Test added (write-only registration + a second hook does not disturb the first).
3. The per-thread run context is now published (tls_run) only after sigsetjmp has initialised the buffer, in both n2a32_run and the stack-argument fault guard, so a signal arriving in that window chains instead of longjmping into an uninitialised jmp_buf.
4. n2a32_call stack-argument test now passes 8 args (4 register + 4 stack) and expects the full sum, instead of reading two uninitialised stack words.

Everything else in DONE V02 rev 1 stands: routing (T01 corpus 0 mismatches on all ARM configs; V12 7/7, V10 12/12, V14 453/453), IT, nested/interworking calls, NULL-fn unresolved slots for V03, faults, MMIO, excl, TSan. Still not compiled for arm64 iOS, not run on the phone, no performance numbers.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/emu/{n2a32_core.c,n2a32_mem.c,n2a32_excl.c,n2a32_stub_classes.c,build.mk,test_v02/**}; STATUS updated in gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V02/STATUS.md. Available for further review findings.
